message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover layout with a large, stylized architectural drawing and a single human figure. The background consists of tall, geometric buildings with light tan and grey surfaces, featuring horizontal lines that suggest paneling or windows. The central building has a sharp, jutting overhang. On a sidewalk below, a man stands with his arms folded across his chest. He has grey hair, wears glasses, a bright yellow collared shirt, and grey trousers. A small car is visible further down a grey street.

The top of the cover displays the red word "TEMPO" in a serif font. Above it, black text reads "GERILYA DI KONGRES DEMOKRAT" and "KISAH LION AIR BORONG AIRBUS". Below the masthead is "EDISI 25-31 MARET 2013". The main headline in bold black letters reads "GEDUNG LANCUNG BANK JABAR," followed by three lines of smaller black text: "Bank milik pemerintah daerah ini diguncang skandal pembelian gedung. Kader PKS disorot." In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode, a price of "RP 33.000," and website information. The entire image is bordered by a solid red frame.
